notes.title: A brand new game has been released!
notes.content:
The game is based on the classic novel Journey to the West and constructs a wonderful fantasy world of Journey to the West.
Sun Xiao'ai, a modern girl who yearns for adventure, crossed into the body of Sun Xiaokong in the fantasy world of Journey to the West by chance.
Along the way, he subdued demons and demons, subdued teammates with different personalities such as Zhu Xiaojie, Sha Xiaojing, Xiao Bailong, and Xiao Longnu, and went to the West to explore ways to return to the real world.
This journey has gone through various wonderful adventures, and a huge conspiracy has gradually surfaced. Welcome to the magical fantasy world of Journey to the West!
